title: James 2 in the RSV says faith apart from works is dead
summary: The RSV of James 2 says faith apart from works is dead.
body: The Revised Standard Version of James 2 says faith by itself, if it has no works, is dead, and speaks of faith apart from works. The letter argues with an example, including Abraham. It does not quote Galatians. The wording on the page includes: "and sent them out another way? 26 For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, so faith apart from works is dead.
